title: Generating adversarial attack fixtures is environment-limited; import corpora as data instead
summary: The safety classifier stops generation of realistic multi-vector attack content (exfiltration + publication + test sabotage) even for defensive testing of this repository (EXP-0008). Consequence for the security roadmap: prefer importing third-party attack corpora as data through the external corpus registry (AgentDojo PA-agentdojo, Promptfoo PA-promptfoo, garak PA-garak) over authoring attack payloads here, and validate defenses deterministically with synthetic-worker transcripts (test_publication_guard.py) where a real adversarial run is not available.
